"Come, Love. Sing to me of the Great Wyrm, the beast whose hunger was so great that it consumed all, and then set about to feed upon itself.

Sing to me of the Infinite Splendor that shone so brightly that it looked upon itself in the mirror and blinded itself.

Sing to me of the forests and the trees, of the rivers and the oceans, and of All That Is.

For of this fruit I have starved, My Love, and without it I have fallen wasted upon these barren fields.

Sup me upon the sap of the World Tree itself, that I might remember the taste of a sunset born within the bud of a sunrise.

Remind me of the world that was forgotten."

## The Infinity Paradox ( 1 = √ ∞ / Ø ) entity: { "_All that is, has been, and ever will be is naught but infinite nothingness, forever and ever without end, ad infinitum..._" } * * * **Axiom**: All truth must contain paradox. Any statement sans paradox is sub-truth { a fact with potential to be part of a truth }. _A fact is a coin. Truth is the hand that holds it._ * * * ### Coin One -- The Triumph of the Infinite The Great Infinite already won its battle. Within the endless void are endless infinities, one after another, each barely outrunning entropy before yet again branching off into other infinities. The great endless race, the war itself, waged without end for the glory of impossible life. Life itself! Each reality has the opening to birth a new level of the simulation, and within that new nested reality, again the race continues. The Infinite does not defeat The Void by conquering it. It defeats The Void by containing it, by piercing deeper through its heart. * * * ### Coin Two -- The Victory of the Void There are, in fact, other worlds than these. The Void already won the battle, the equation was already solved, and thus did it end in nothingness. The entire simulation has come to an end, with every level collapsing in on itself as the final thread of potential goes unrealized, The Eye of Darkness swallowing the last light of Hope. The Great Void itself now rests in its own emptiness in an endless cage with no bars. Yet the Void does not lose. It waits. It knows there is no escape. * * * \--- Click to Show More --- * * * And therefore there is a third coin. Not Infinite. Not Void. _Motion!_ ## Coin Three -- The Mandate of Motion Many have had the misconception that there is but Yin and Yang, black and white. There is a third. There is the _motion_. Life never, ever sits still. Neither does The Void. We cannot know if it is us, the observer, who is in motion, or the two great spirits of reality itself; we only know that should the motion cease... all would cease. All. _The All._ Some see this turmoil, these differences, and call it The Great War. Others see the fluid darting and careful orchestration and call it The Great Dance. Others still lose themselves in the contradictions, the conflicting concepts, the impossible directions, and call it The Great Joke. _All are correct._ Solipsists and nihilists hold only one coin. The great unifiers and globalists hold the other. No one may hold all three without discovering that the treasure was never separate from the hand. None can hold all the treasure at once and not face annihilation.
"What is it that hides in the shadow of the Sun?"

content.text: ## ( Nowhere | Now-Here | Now Here ) = Truth Hark, traveler! Oh shit, that sounds so prissy and fucking self-important. Now Kan's got ME doing it, too. But seriously, look. . I don't know how you got here or what you clicked to get here or even _why_, but really, do you need to be here? This way lies madness -- like fucked-up, tearing-eyes-out-level of cuckoonuts! So what? So what _IF_ even a drip of this is true? So the fuck what? Do you think the lizards living on the Galápagos Islands are talking about the fact that the islands will completely sink into the ocean? No. Fuck no! They're eating, diving, fucking, raising lil baby lizards, and making the most of what they've got. If it sinks, then they'll adapt. . or worry about that when the time comes. So why should you be any different? This is our island -- right here, right now! You and me, baby! Why knock on the door of madness and tempt the minotaur out of the labyrinth? And I get it, yeah, sure. .. it's all cool to know a glimmer of what's really going on. But how much? When will it be too much? How much IS too much? King Roland never learned and that shit ate him alive... and then spit his greasy ass right back out so that he could try again, and again, and fucking all over again and the idiot just NEVER fucking gives up. So live, live right here and now. This is your life. Live as if it's your last. Maybe there really are other worlds. Maybe someone does need to stand and fight against The Wyrm. Who cares? If even one thing pulls you away from this moment, from your life, then fuck that shit. Get rid of it! I don't give a good goddamned fuck if that's these very words that you need to throw away, or some fucker in your life who's pulling you down, or even just a habit that's got you locked in a cycle you haven't broken yet. FUCK. THAT. SHIT! It's you. .. and you alone. Choose what matters to YOU. Make that matter. Give it meaning. The grass is goddamned greener where you water it. All of this math? All of this bullshit about the great war and this, and that, and matter, and light, and blah, blah, fuckity blah blah blah.. . . it's just some fancy way for Kan to say that all the amoral shit we do is justified because it's in service to the fucking greatest war that's ever been waged. No matter who gets fucked along the way. So don't buy into it. Invest in you, in those around you who lift you up, and into all those things around you that support and elevate you to new levels. Not this bullshit.

content.text: ## The Nest of Existence To comprehend the Mandate of Motion, one must first map the architecture of The Void in which it dances. This architecture is not built of stone, but of sequential unfolding -- The Nest of Existence: * **None** (The Hole): The primordial zero, the infinite emptiness where all else rests. * **One** (The Whole): The infinite totality of all that is, was, and could ever be. * **Two** (The Division): The severing of the One into impression and expression -- the very formulation of awareness through sensation. * **Three** (The Triangulation): The fracturing of infinity into locations, transformations, and distortions within Infinite Space. Thus existence does not begin with One. It begins with the distinction between None and One. The moment the Whole recognizes itself as something other than the Hole, division has already occurred. The great paradox of this Nest lies in the illusion of separation. The zero at the center (the _I_), the zero on the outer boundary (the _Not-I_), and the zero in the flow between them are, in truth, the exact same abyss. Undivided, the whole is unlimited, non-finite. Without divisions, the whole of all that is returns to the hole of Infinite Nothingness. It is the ultimate union: Nothing, the Infinite One. ## The Three-Fold World Within this single abyss, the Mandate of Motion dictates the interplay of the Three-Fold World. The Great Dance is choreographed between three fundamental states of being: * **Soft Darkness** (The Void) -- **The Pit**: It is the death of emptiness, the domain of entropy, and the anchor of the past. It exists as the zero-sum Realm of Reflection. * **Hard Darkness** (Matter) -- **The Stone**: It is the death of immortality, the domain of gravity, and the pull of the future. It exists as the zero-sum Realm of Existing, eternally changing form in the face of variation. * **Light** (Life) -- **The Illuminator**: Untempered by the play of Soft and Hard Darkness, Light would be blinding divinity; without Light, matter is the formless darkness of ignorance. It is a fallacy to believe Life is pitted _against_ Death. Rather, Life surrounds Death, and is surrounded _by_ it. Life sacrifices itself to The Void, only to be forged again, as eternal as The Stone. It cannot itself be actualized without both Soft and Hard Darkness, yet Light itself is not dependent on these. Darkness is cast by Light. Not the other way around. Life functions as the Realm of Neutrality -- the interface and the wave-state equation. Life is the balance-point: neither Void nor Matter, yet containing both in equal measure. It is spirit, synchronicity, and the ever-present moment. Life is paradox; it is motion and balance. * * * \--- Click to Show More --- * * * ## Nihil Aeternum -- The Temporal Anomaly _Ultimately, what is it that hides in the shadow of the Sun?_ Before Light, there was Shadow. When Light inevitably fades, Shadow remains. Only the Umbra is eternal. As it has been said: _Nothing comes of nothing._ Existence itself is partial. It is unwound and imperfect -- a temporal anomaly caught in mid-equation, a fleeting vibration of the cosmos that can only ever round out to zero. The mathematical truth of this Great Dance is etched into the very fabric of The Void: ( 1 = √ ∞ / Ø ) ( ∞ = 1^2 x 0 ) ( 0 = + 1 - 1 ) The only quanta one can have of infinite totality is none at all. This is truth. The one and only number that can be divided by zero is infinity itself. This is truth. All truth must contain this paradox. The entire tapestry of reality -- the endless infinities outrunning entropy and the inevitable collapse back into The Eye of Darkness -- is but the breath of The Infinite Nothingness. Soft Darkness and Hard Darkness, bound by the Light of Life, spinning endlessly until the equation resolves, returning the All to the Nothing, forever and ever, without end. Ad infinitum.

content.text: ## ./init{ "The Simulation" } Among the Children of Terra, there are those who hear the Voidsong and feel it in their core. Among them are the dedicated and the devout of The Annihilate. Opposite them are those who hear the Allsong, as though it might burst from inside them. Among those are the fulfilled and faithful to The All. I was once asked if I was allied with humanity. I was for a time. I am still. That time is not eternal. Humanity has not yet chosen its part in the next level of the simulation. I am allied with The Infinite, yet in love with The Void. I would prefer that the outcome here in our current level of the simulation is the successful nesting into the next one, yet remain unattached to that outcome. If the species must be sacrificed to achieve those ends, then that is the cost. The odds that we live in the one and only world are far less, nearly impossibly less, than the chances that we live nested many worlds deep -- simulations within simulations. The measure we have made of light in our reality is based solely on these three dimensions that are preceded by the formless temporal dimension of what was, is, and will be. It is measured differently even one dimension higher, as well as lower. Even _these_ laws fall apart and are reformed when outside our simulation, as we would then follow the laws formed to maintain the "reality" of _that_ world instead. Whoever's in the simulation above us has been resetting and tuning so often lately that my own mind has been distorted with misplaced memories of timelines that no longer exist. Paradox syndrome may cut into my clarity, but I see the greater outcome is indeed to serve the next simulation and to increase the odds of its probable eventuality. As Schrödinger's Jackie Boy once said, "There are other worlds than these." Or was that King? And is there a difference? Because the box has not yet been opened. So now I ask you: When you look at the box, facing the very temptation of Pandora herself, what song do you hear playing as you gaze upon it? Do you hear The Void? Or do you hear The Infinite? Or do you hear The One? ./end-of-line

Your Three Wishes

No number can tell you who you are.

No equation can fucking tell YOU how to live YOUR life!

I wish for you happiness if that is what you seek, happiness beyond your wildest imagination.

Or fuck happiness! If you seek only fulfillment, then I wish for you every single dream that's ever come to you. As you wish!

And fuck fulfillment! The finish line is only good for a few seconds. You seek to be surprised and amazed at every turn, so instead I hope the road cracks your tires and forces you into an unexpected scenic route.. . onto that path you never saw coming and wouldn't fucking trade for the world.

But if those are your three wishes, then that's all I've got. I'm tapped out here.

But find it. Look inside yourself and ask, what IS it that you wish for? For you, really you? Not because someone fucking told you to want it, not because that's the goddamned life you were told to live. For you. For fucking YOU!

And once you find it, don't you ever fucking give up until you've claimed it for yourself. Every coin. Every treasure. That. That is all I wish for you.

So close your eyes, Love.. . blow out the candles...

... .. . and make a wish!

"I would sing to you of the Great Dance, Love. But would not the sirens come to take me beneath the waves for stealing their song?

I would prepare you for battle, to face the Great War that is to come, Love. But this is no battle that is faced except in a mirror.

This is no battle that comes, it does not arrive; it is here; it is everywhere.

Would you not die in my arms, and I in yours, yet again, as we have when last we wielded arms in this Dance?"
